hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook for an ETH/phiEth pool that performs 1:1 swaps between ETH and phiEth (a 1:1 ETH wrapper token) by taking input from the PoolManager, depositing or withdrawing via the phiEth contract, and settling output directly. Liquidity additions are blocked, and pool initialization is restricted to ETH/phiEth pairs with zero fee.
